newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the blue-chip Dow index jumped 154.93 points, or 1.96 percent, to 8,061.65 after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks assured Wall Street that interest rates will remain steady for some time.

* Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said on Tuesday the government had no plans to alter monetary policy in the wake of a speculative attack on the rupiah which pushed the currency to a historic low against the dollar on Monday.

* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 0.96 points, or 0.13 percent, lower at 711.44 points, with newly-listed counters staging modest debuts despite cautious sentiment because of the weak rupiah, brokers said.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was traded at 2,535.00/45.00 at 0150 GMT against an opening of 2,570.00/80.00.
* Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia on news that it expects to post poor first half results.
* Textile firm Panasia Filamen and Lippo General Insurance after modest debuts on Tuesday.
* Plastics manufacturer Langgeng Makmur as it was expected to resume trading later today after the exchange suspended trading in the stock late on Tuesday.
* Small-sized Bank Ficorinvest after an announcement that privately-owned securities firm Bhakti Investama bought a 14.53 percent stake, worth some 40 billion rupiah, in the bank.
* Alumunium firm Indal after recent sharp rises due to reports it planned to form a joint venture firm.
